|---|---|---|---|---|
| Left | MLP (1 frame) | 84.2% | 2.61 | 6.9 (232 ms) |
| Left | MLP + vote 3 of 5 | 81.6% | 1.33 | 10.2 (339 ms) |
| Left | GRU (8 frames) | 82.5% | 2.04 | 7.7 (256 ms) |
| Right | MLP (1 frame) | 93.3% | 2.37 | 1.1 (35 ms) |
| Right | MLP + vote 3 of 5 | 93.3% | 0.95 | 4.0 (132 ms) |
| Right | GRU (8 frames) | 95.6% | 0.60 | 5.0 (167 ms) |
